headlines: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 2 AM EDT FRIDAY THROUGH SATURDAY MORNING

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: East winds 10 to 15 knots becoming southwest 15 to 20 knots. A chance of showers with a slight chance of thunderstorms early, then showers likely with a slight chance of thunderstorms. A chance of showers with a slight chance of thunderstorms late. Waves 1 to 3 feet.

periods.name: Friday
periods.text: West winds 15 to 25 knots becoming northwest. A chance of showers with a slight chance of thunderstorms in the morning, then showers likely in the afternoon. Waves 2 to 4 feet building to 3 to 5 feet. Waves occasionally around 6 feet.

periods.name: Friday night
periods.text: North winds to 30 knots. A chance of showers in the evening. Waves 3 to 6 feet building to 4 to 7 feet. Waves occasionally around 9 feet.

periods.name: Saturday
periods.text: North winds to 30 knots becoming northwest and diminishing to 5 to 15 knots in the afternoon. Sunny. Waves 3 to 6 feet subsiding to 1 to 3 feet. Waves occasionally around 7 feet.

notes: Winds and waves higher in and near thunderstorms.
See Lake Erie open lakes forecast for Sunday through Tuesday.
The water temperature off Toledo is 65 degrees, off Cleveland 66 degrees, and off Erie 64 degrees.
